column1: # producer   by hand: measured precision of the mapping to the originals, read by the owner's console (texts page)
# One row per measurement actually made. An estimate is not a measurement and has no row here.
#   text       the text's slug, or * for a method measured on its own benchmark
#   original   BHSA, NESTLE1904 or TR1894, or * for every original of the text
#   method     the method whose links were judged (stated, strong, evidentia, composed, aligner, names, ...), or all
#   band       the links judged by how sure the method is of them: all, >=0.9, 0.7-0.9 or <0.7
#   kind       precision: judged against a reference taken as right (a hand alignment, a hand-scored sample);
#              agreement: two independent sources compared word by word, neither taken as right
#   precision  the share judged right, in percent; a word is right when every original word its link names is one the reference names
#   n          how many words were judged
#   against    what they were judged against
#   source     the ticket that holds the measurement
#   note       anything a reader of the figure needs
